subject: Media Literacy
title: How Online Ads Track You
description: A fast breakdown of How Online Ads Track You for builders.

hook.text: You searched for hiking boots once. Now every website shows you hiking boot ads for the next month.

buildup.text: Online advertising tracks your behavior using cookies, pixels, and device fingerprints across the web.

discovery.text: Advertisers build profiles from your searches, clicks, location, purchases, and even mouse movements.

twist.text: These profiles are so detailed that advertisers often know about major life events before your family does.

climax.text: You browse the web thinking you're alone. In reality, thousands of trackers are watching and recording.

punchline.text: You're not searching the internet. The internet is searching you.

quiz.question: How do online advertisers track user behavior?
options: Through cookies, pixels, and device fingerprints
